label: Emergency numbers
text: 922 (national emergency medical line) or the Kenya Red Cross on 1199
note: 922 launched Aug 2026 and is known only from news reports; 999/112 reach police and are unreliable for ambulances. TEST-CALL before verifying.

label: Complaints about public hospitals (free)
text: Office of the Ombudsman, toll-free 0800 221 349, complain@ombudsman.go.ke

check_against.label: Office of the Ombudsman: complaints portal

label: Free legal help
text: National Legal Aid Service toll-free 0800 720 640, or Kituo cha Sheria on 0734 874 221.
note: Seen on official sites. Confirm they take hospital-detention cases.

label: If a complaint is not resolved
text: Kenya Health Professions Oversight Authority, 0742 157 424, info@khpoa.go.ke

label: Gender-based and sexual violence support
text: the national gender-based violence helpline 1195 (free, 24 hours). For a child, the child helpline 116 (free).

label: Someone to talk to now
text: Kenya Red Cross counselling on 1199 (free), or Befrienders Kenya on 0722 178 177 (daytime).
